exposure: Robotic-assisted transvaginal surgical management (resection of transverse vaginal septum, repair of congenital urethra-vaginal fistula, vaginoplasty)
outcome: Delivery of a child by caesarean section
cohort: A 24-year-old female presenting with cyclical hematuria, dyspareunia, and primary infertility due to congenital urethra-vaginal fistula and transverse vaginal septum.
finding: Robotic-assisted transvaginal surgery successfully managed a case of congenital urethra-vaginal fistula with transverse vaginal septum, leading to normal menstruation, conception, and subsequent delivery.
mod_finding: The patient successfully delivered a child by caesarean section following the robotic-assisted surgical intervention.
